signal: UptimeHealth ranked No. 110 on the 2025 Inc. 5000 (No. 6 in Software) and is exploring 2026 expansion into Florida, North Carolina, and Georgia

email.body1:
Sean, saw UptimeHealth hit No. 110 on the Inc. 5000 and is eyeing expansion into Florida, the Carolinas, and Georgia in 2026.

Opening new markets usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for UptimeHealth off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Sean, quick follow-up for UptimeHealth.

Expanding into several new metros at once, the pipeline target tends to climb faster than you can hire reps to cover each market. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings each new region needs to pull its weight.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings each new market needs, and where the math breaks if you only add headcount.
email.body3:
Sean, last bit of proof for UptimeHealth.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how UptimeHealth's reply rate likely compares to other fast-growing healthtech companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Sean, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline into the new markets without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up several metros at once is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a multi-market expansion? I'll tailor it to UptimeHealth either way.
